subject: Hosted API quickstart — next steps & rate limits
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@finco.com>, Priya Narang <priya.narang@finco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API quickstart — next steps & rate limits

Hi Sam / Priya —

Great to meet the FinCo team earlier today — thanks for the time and for walking through your fraud-detection use case. Quick recap and recommended next steps for a Hosted API evaluation (since you want the fastest path to iterate):

1) Why Hosted API for the quick evaluation
- Fastest onboarding: no infra to provision.
- Full feature set for evaluation: chat/gen endpoints, streaming, and embeddings available immediately.
- We can temporarily increase rate limits for short evaluations if needed.

2) Typical Hosted API limits (default) — we can request increases for the eval:
- Requests: 60 requests/minute (burst to ~120)
- Concurrent streaming sessions: 5 by default
- Token throughput: handled automatically; typical evals for your workload sit well below limits, but we can scale for stress tests.

If you anticipate steady production traffic or require guaranteed throughput/SLAs for the pilot, Dedicated capacity is the next step — we can discuss reserved pools and predictable throughput later. For regulated data requiring VPC or on-prem, our Private deployment is available but will add onboarding time.

Next steps I'd propose:
- I’ll provision a Hosted API quickstart project for FinCo and upload a Postman collection + short quickstart guide (attached).
- Please share one representative prompt and expected output for a small eval set (5–10 examples).
- Tell me the target concurrency or RPS you'd like us to enable for the short test (we can provision an elevated limit for 48–72 hours).

Attached: redwood_quickstart_instructions.pdf, postman_collection_redwood.json
Quick links: https://app.redwood.ai/quickstart/FIN-2027

Sample curl to get started:
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-23b","input":"Give me an executive summary of transaction 12345"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

I’ll loop in Marissa (CS lead) to handle trial billing and any SOC2/security questionnaire items.

Any other constraints (data retention, IP, ingress/egress rules) we should be aware of up front?

Thanks — happy to set the quickstart up this afternoon if that works for you.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Sam Patel <sam@finco.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Narang <priya.narang@finco.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API quickstart — next steps & rate limits

Thanks, Aditya —

Appreciate the clear next steps. Hosted API sounds like the right place for our initial evaluation. A couple of quick questions before you spin up the project: 

- Can you bump request limits to ~300 requests/minute and 20 concurrent streams for the 72-hour stress window? We want to run some parallel load tests against sample traffic.
- Our security team will want an exported copy of your SOC 2 report and confirmation around data retention and deletion for eval logs.
- Timeline: can you get the quickstart project and Postman collection to us by EOD tomorrow? If so, we’ll run through our 5-test-cases early next week.

I’ll attach the sample prompts and expected outputs in a follow-up. Also, what’s the recommended way to pass PII fields during evaluation — should we mask them client-side or can we use redaction headers?

Thanks — Sam
Sam Patel
Principal Data Scientist | FinCo
sam@finco.com | +1 (646) 555-0123
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@finco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priya Narang <priya.narang@finco.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API quickstart — next steps & rate limits

Hi Sam / Priya —

Great — we can absolutely support the plan. Quick answers and updates: 

1) Temporary elevated limits
- I’ve requested a 72-hour bump to 300 requests/minute and 20 concurrent streaming sessions for FinCo. Ops has provisioned the increase and I’ll confirm once it’s live (target: within 2 hours).

2) Security / SOC 2 / data retention
- Marissa (cc’d) will send the latest SOC 2 report and the one-pager on our evaluation data retention controls (we delete most eval logs after 30 days by default; can shorten for trials if required).
- For PII during evaluation, we recommend client-side masking where possible. If you need server-side redaction, we can enable a limited redaction flow for the pilot — Marissa can coordinate.

3) Timeline & deliverables
- I’ve attached redwood_quickstart_instructions.pdf and the Postman collection.
- I’ll create a trial project in the app and invite the emails you provided. Expect the project + temporary API key in a separate, secure email (we don’t paste keys inline).

4) Next call
- Would Monday 10am PT work to walk through running the 5 test cases and any adjustments to prompts? If so, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Marissa — could you please drop the SOC2 and evaluation retention doc and confirm who from CS will own the trial billing?

Thanks — looking forward to the tests.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
